title: aim
description: What the orchestrator gives `steering aim` on stdin, for it to take into the steering: the work's opportunity solution tree, its tasks, and its decisions, each whole as the orchestrator weighed them. A task that the steering already holds at the same path keeps where it is on its way, unless the aim says what it takes next.

tasks.description: What's left to do for the target solution, first to last.

next.description: Where the weighing decides what the task takes next: generator, to make it again on what was weighed, within LIMIT judged Rounds; anew, to make it again from its first Round, as the solution it was made on changed; fixer, to mend it; refactorer, to refactor it. Absent, it goes on as the steering holds it. A task that's done is left out of the aim.
